articles.event_key: Google DeepMind|发布|Antigravity化学信息学能力
articles.title: DeepMind展示Antigravity化学信息学技能，称一小时提出候选大环
articles.summary: Google DeepMind在官方博客展示Antigravity配合Cheminformatics Skills的药物发现工作流：基于RDKit并连接ChEMBL、PubChem，代理可检索数千化合物、做匹配分子对分析，并在约一小时提出带合成路线的刚性大环候选。结果为官方演示。
articles.new_facts: DeepMind发布Antigravity化学信息学技能；官方演示约一小时完成化合物检索、匹配分子对分析和候选大环设计。

facts.text: Google DeepMind在11月3日的官方博客中展示，Google Antigravity配合新的Cheminformatics Skills可加速药物发现工作流。

evidence.quote: Here we show how Google Antigravity , equipped with our new Cheminformatics Skills, accelerates drug discovery workflows.

facts.text: 该技能套件基于开源化学信息学工具RDKit，并连接ChEMBL和PubChem的整理资源；语言模型负责流程编排、数据库导航和科学推理，确定性化学工具执行分子计算。

evidence.quote: we built a suite of Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity
alongside connectors to curated resources from ChEMBL and PubChem

The skills also create a division of labour where the underlying language model handles workflow orchestration, database navigation and scientific reasoning, while deterministic chemistry tools execute molecular calculations.

facts.text: 官方以真实肺癌治疗药物为例，称代理检索数千种化合物、进行匹配分子对分析，并在约一小时内提出带合成路线的刚性大环候选。上述为官方演示结果。

evidence.quote: an agent searches through thousands of compounds, performs matched molecular pair analysis, and proposes novel rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in just an hour.

articles.limitations: 内容来自Google DeepMind官方博客的演示，未提供独立评测或完整基准；文中“约一小时”为官方演示描述。

bilingual.title_en: DeepMind Demonstrates Antigravity Cheminformatics Skills, Says It Proposed Candidate Macrocycles in One Hour

sentences.en: In an official blog post on November 3, Google DeepMind demonstrated that Google Antigravity, combined with new Cheminformatics Skills, can accelerate drug discovery workflows.
sentences.zh: Google DeepMind在11月3日的官方博客中展示，Google Antigravity配合新的Cheminformatics Skills可加速药物发现工作流。

sentences.en: The skills suite is based on the open-source cheminformatics toolkit RDKit and connects to curated resources from ChEMBL and PubChem; the language model handles workflow orchestration, database navigation, and scientific reasoning, while deterministic chemistry tools perform molecular calculations.
sentences.zh: 该技能套件基于开源化学信息学工具RDKit，并连接ChEMBL和PubChem的整理资源；语言模型负责流程编排、数据库导航和科学推理，确定性化学工具执行分子计算。

sentences.en: In an official example using a real lung cancer treatment drug, the agent was said to have retrieved thousands of compounds, performed matched molecular pair analysis, and proposed rigid macrocycle candidates with synthetic routes in about one hour.
sentences.zh: 官方以真实肺癌治疗药物为例，称代理检索数千种化合物、进行匹配分子对分析，并在约一小时内提出带合成路线的刚性大环候选。

sentences.en: The above are results from an official demonstration.

articles.title: openJiuwen上线AgentMemory多模态记忆，称长视频问答时延最高降97%
articles.summary: openJiuwen在AgentMemory 0.2.0上线OmniMem-Lens多模态记忆能力，项目方称通过视觉和听觉双流按事件切分长视频，并公布Video-MME-L、LVbench、EgoLife-QA上的测试提升及时延数据。
articles.new_facts: openJiuwen AgentMemory 0.2.0上线OmniMem-Lens；项目方称视听双流按事件切分长视频，Video-MME-L提升8%、LVbench提升6.4%、EgoLife-QA提升45.7%，在线时延最高降97%。

facts.text: openJiuwen在AgentMemory 0.2.0上线OmniMem-Lens多模态记忆能力，项目方称其通过视觉和听觉双流按真实事件切分长视频，并用三层记忆结构离线建库、在线检索。

evidence.quote: openJiuwen AgentMemory 正式上线了多模态记忆能力 OmniMem-Lens
通过 视觉 和 听觉 两条轨迹来理解视频中的事件
OmniMem-Lens在后台建立了一个三层记忆单元
记忆离线建，回答在线查

facts.text: 项目方公布测试称，配合Qwen3-VL-8B，OmniMem-Lens在Video-MME-L上召回精度提升8%，LVbench提升6.4%，EgoLife-QA提升45.7%；在线问答时延最高降低97%，LVbench从34.5秒降至1.72秒。

evidence.quote: 在通用长视频基准Video-MME-L上提升8%，长视频理解基准LVbench上提升6.4%。
在线问答时延最高降低 97%

facts.text: 该能力已在openJiuwen AgentMemory 0.2.0版本正式上线。

evidence.quote: OmniMem-Lens已在openJiuwen AgentMemory 0.2.0版本正式上线

articles.limitations: 内容来自量子位获授权刊载的项目方文章，测试数据由项目方公布，未见独立复现；文章所称“首次”未独立核实。

bilingual.title_en: openJiuwen launches AgentMemory multimodal memory, claims up to 97% lower latency in long-video question answering

sentences.en: openJiuwen has launched the OmniMem-Lens multimodal memory capability in AgentMemory 0.2.0; the project team says it segments long videos by real events through visual and auditory dual streams and uses a three-layer memory structure for offline database construction and online retrieval.
sentences.zh: openJiuwen在AgentMemory 0.2.0上线OmniMem-Lens多模态记忆能力，项目方称其通过视觉和听觉双流按真实事件切分长视频，并用三层记忆结构离线建库、在线检索。

sentences.en: The project team published tests claiming that, with Qwen3-VL-8B, OmniMem-Lens improved recall accuracy by 8% on Video-MME-L, by 6.4% on LVbench, and by 45.7% on EgoLife-QA; online question-answering latency fell by up to 97%, with LVbench dropping from 34.5 seconds to 1.72 seconds.
sentences.zh: 项目方公布测试称，配合Qwen3-VL-8B，OmniMem-Lens在Video-MME-L上召回精度提升8%，LVbench提升6.4%，EgoLife-QA提升45.7%；在线问答时延最高降低97%，LVbench从34.5秒降至1.72秒。

sentences.en: The capability has officially launched in openJiuwen AgentMemory version 0.2.0.
sentences.zh: 该能力已在openJiuwen AgentMemory 0.2.0版本正式上线。
